title: Recovery of Article 349, April 1960 (U-2 emergency landing site, Japan)
description: Two black-and-white photographs captioned "Recovery of Article 349, April 1960." The top image shows the tail of a U-2 in a grassy field with trees behind; the bottom shows the aircraft resting on the ground viewed from above, with people and vehicles around it. Chapter 5 text (page 220) notes resulting controversy in Japan and the 1960 withdrawal of Detachment C.
